quotes.text: Oh, another one!
Do you happen to remember anything about being turned to stone?
Probably not.
But I hear there's a cure.
If you can find a way to the moon, the moonicorn might be able to help you.
I myself have tried but have gotten stuck here.
The lady unicorn to the east has gotten farther than me.
Maybe she can help you.
Would you, perhaps, say hi to her for me?
Moon to Merky...
Moon to Merky...
Moon to Merky...
Come in Merky...
Merky! Is that you?
Oh Merky, it's you! It's... Oh, it's so good to see your face!
Quick! There's no time to lose. You need to come to the moon ASAP!
Merky! You made it! I'm so glad you're here.
Now, let's get out of here!
(this is the end of the game)
(ENDING 1: ESCAPE)
Oh hay! I forgot to tell you how to get to the moon.
There's a shuttle pod in the desert that should still be operational.
There's also the railgun transport system...
Oh I see you found it already!
Yeah I don't know if it still works, but it's worth a try.
Oh hay! I forgot to tell you how to get to the moon.
But I see you're already at the railgun transport system! Excellent!
I'm running a diagnostic now...
Just a moment...
It appears to be functional. It doesn't have any power though.
Well, I hate to bother them, but you're going to need to go see Transistor.
They can show you how to power this device.
Their workshop is in the Northwest Pole, but it's probably been snowed in.
Nimbus has been "hard at work" doing what he calls "disproving the apocalypse"...
So, good luck finding Transistor. They could be anywhere inside their workshop, and they don't usually answer the door. ...or the phone...
But if you do find them, say hi to them for me? Thanks Merky.
Oh hay! I forgot to tell you how to get to the moon.
There's a shuttle pod in the desert that should still be operational.
There's also the railgun transport system, but that hasn't been used in a while. I'm not sure it's still operational.
Or if you can somehow fly, it doesn't matter. Just get here quick.
Oh hay! I forgot to tell you how to get to the moon.
There's a shuttle pod in the desert that should still be operational.
Oh you already found it!
Yeah I can see it from the moon, it left a pretty big crater.
But I just did a diagnostics check, and it should still work.
Just needs to be powered is all.
Oh hay! Silly me, I forgot to tell you how to get to the moon.
There's a shuttle pod in the desert that should still be operational.
Oh you're already there!
Great!
Hey I know you never got your pilot's license, but it's ok. You're just taking it to the moon. You're not going to get in trouble or anything. It's the apocalypse! Who cares?
But! You do need some power. So, power it first. Get here as soon as you can.
You found the railgun transport system! Excellent!
I'm running a diagnostic now...
Just a moment...
...And it appears to be functional. It doesn't have any power though.
Well, I hate to bother them, but you're going to need to go see Transistor.
They can show you how to power this device.
Their workshop is in the Northwest Pole, but it's probably been snowed in.
Nimbus has been "hard at work" doing what he calls "disproving the apocalypse"...
Ridiculous...
Anyway, good luck finding Transistor. They could be anywhere inside their workshop, and they don't usually answer the door... or the phone...
But if you manage to find them, say hi to them for me? Thanks Merky.
Here it is. The working shuttle pod.
You remember how to pilot these, right Merky?
Pilot this shuttle pod to the moon.
Yeah I know Kaki's still here too.
I tried to convince her to leave, but she blew up at me.
Some ponies are just too unreasonable to deal with.
Let her be.
Yellow is still here? I thought he left already. Huh.
He probably decided to stay with the tree.
It's a real shame we couldn't save it. It's a real nice tree.
Let him enjoy it while it lasts.
Yeah I know Nimbus is here!
His "broadcast" is so loud I can hear it from the moon!
Sometimes I'm glad that he's too stupid to leave...
No, I probably shouldn't think like that.
Anyway, believe me, I've tried to get him to acknowledge the situation. But he just goes on and on about how it's some grand conspiracy!
Ignore him, Merky. Focus on getting to the moon.
Who did you find? Wait who?
Oh yeah! I remember them now.
I suspected she would still be here. She's so quiet, it's hard to tell sometimes.
I wish I could help her, but she's down way too deep.
Don't get dragged down with her, Merky. Just forget about her.
Make it up here to the moon.
I'm glad to hear Transistor is still alive, even if only for now.
I'm really going to miss their daily updates.
If you can get them to leave, that'd be great. But I suspect they're too attached to their factory, literally.
I tried to get Mayor Grunhardt to come, but...
He's all "A captain must go down with his ship."
I respect him, but I really think he should have just come with me.
Power the launcher Merky.
Get to the moon as fast as you can Merky!
What are you doing here, Merky?
Go away and leave me alone!
Don't act like you're stuck down here. I know full well you can teleport.
Oh wow you really are stuck down here.
Fine. I'll teach you Force Launch.
Come on!
What are you waiting for?
Do you want to learn Force Launch or not?
There you go.
Now scram!
Why are you still here?
Leave already!
Hi Merky
Wanna hear a joke?
Why did the apple tree start growing oranges?
It was branching out!
ha ha ha
How are you doing, Merky? Having a nice day?
That's good. I'm doing fine. The tree is lovely and green today.
The sun? Yeah, it's nice and bright today. I bet the tree is loving it.
Would you like to explore the tree too?
Here, have a tree climb.
Glad to see you're enjoying the tree
Merky, what are you doing down here?
You don't remember me? I'm Kelpie!
That's great, Merky, that Io is helping you escape.
I hope the best for you.
Maybe this will help you.
It's the Swap ability. A little something to remember me by.
Goodbye, Merky
Shelly... I miss her.
She was the greatest most bestest snail in the whole world.
Whenever I found myself floating up and away, she'd always be there to keep me in place.
She and I would race around the well.
She'd always win, of course.
I raised her since she was a hatchling.
And now she's... she's...
I miss her
Goodbye, Merky
Welcome Merky
Status: task completion percent is less than 100%
ERROR: Task completion before deadline impossible
CAUSE: Power levels are below minimum required thresholds
Are you willing to assist?
Thank you Merky
You have been granted the Electric Beam ability.
Calculating...
Task completion before deadline is now possible.
Task completion before deadline is now possible.
All the way from the library basement, we have Merky!
The forever note taker himself!
What's new Merky?
Mm hmm, mm hmm
Thank you Merky, that was very nice
Now to talk about the weather!
There was a rain storm that was supposed to happen today in the desert
But it looks like it's going to be sunny all day instead!
That'll make Kaki happy, I'm sure
Anyway, we've got breaking news
The planet is NOT in any danger right now
So don't worry!
That's it for this broadcast
I've been your host, Nimbus
Tune in next time for the New Ponyville Broadcast
We'll be here, rain or shine!
Thanks for coming on the show Merky.
It gets lonely up here sometimes
Thanks for coming on the show Merky!
OH WHOA
My dear boy, don't sneak up on me like that
What am I doing down here?
I must deactivate the planet's core before it becomes decommissioned
It's standard empire operating procedure for the death of a planet
I'm sorry, Merky, I know how much you love this planet
But all good things must come to an end
Speaking of ends, I've seemed to have reached a dead one.
I can't seem to get past some ice here in the way
If I help you increase your teleport range, can you deactivate the planet's core for me?
Thank you, my dear boy
Did you deactivate the planet's core?
Thank you, my dear boy.
Now with that complete, we can both leave.
Oh.
Oh dear.
I appear to be stuck here, Merky. My magic's not what it used to be.
Empire law dictates that a mayor in failing health appoint a deputy as the successor.
Are there any deputies still here, Merky?
No? Well, if you find one, give them this written of successorhood.
Thank you, Merky.
Have you a found a deputy?
Welcome Merky
Greeting received!
Sending greeting to Io regarding "Hi"
Request acknowledged.
Task received: help Merky escape moon.
You have now been granted the Electric Beam ability.
Does that accomplish the task to your satisfaction?
Acknowledged, task accomplished.
Good luck in accomplishing your task, Merky
